messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ನಾನು ಜೂಲಿಯೊರ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆದರೂ ತಡವಾಗಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ್ದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ನಾನು ರೋಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಆಗಸ್ಟ್‌ಸ್‌ರ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸಿದ್ದೆ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳುವ ದೇವರುಗಳ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Nacqui | “I was born” (1st sg perfect) | ಜನಿಸಿದ್ದೆ | “was born” | OK | | sub | preposition “under” (temporal/political) | ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ | “under” | OK | | Iulio | proper name “Julio” (object of *sub*) | ಜೂಲಿಯೊರ | “Julio’s” | OK | | ancor | concessive adverb “though / even though” | ಆದರೂ | “though” | OK | | che | subordinator introducing concessive clause | — (absorbed by ಆದರೂ) | — | UNNECESSARY | | fosse | subjunctive “was” (state of lateness) | — (absorbed in ತಡವಾಗಿ) | — | UNNECESSARY | | tardi | adjective “late” (adverbial) | ತಡವಾಗಿ | “late‑ly” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | vissi | “I lived” (1st sg perfect) | ವಾಸಿಸಿದ್ದೆ | “lived” | OK | | a | preposition “at / in” (location) | — (expressed by suffix ‑ದಲ್ಲಿ) | — | UNNECESSARY | | Roma | proper name “Rome” (locative) | ರೋಮ | “Rome” | OK | | sotto | preposition “under” (political) | ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ | “under” | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” (elided) | — (not needed in Kannada) | — | UNNECESSARY | | buono | adjective “good” (qualifier) | ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ | “good” | OK | | Augusto | proper name “Augustus” (object of *sotto*) | ಆಗಸ್ಟ್‌ಸ್‌ರ | “Augustus’s” | OK | | nel | preposition + article “in the” (temporal) | — (expressed by suffix ‑ದಲ್ಲಿ) | — | UNNECESSARY | | tempo | noun “time” | ಕಾಲ | “time” | OK | | de | preposition “of” (genitive) | — (genitive expressed by suffix ‑ಗಳ) | — | UNNECESSARY | | li | definite article “the” (plural) | — (not needed) | — | UNNECESSARY | | dèi | noun “gods” (plural) | ದೇವರುಗಳ | “gods’” | OK | | falsi | adjective “false” (plural) | ಸುಳ್ಳು | “false” | OK | | e (line 72) | coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | “and” | OK | | bugiardi | adjective “lying” (plural) | ಹೇಳುವ | “telling (lies)” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `che`, `fosse`, `’l`, `de`, `li`, `a`, `nel` – these function words are naturally omitted in Kannada because case‑marking suffixes convey the same relations. - **No MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR** issues were detected; the Kannada translation respects number, gender and case conventions.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
